payload.answer: Never relax any gate: the four 100 percent branch-coverage floors, mypy --strict, import-linter onion contracts, bandit, and the protected test files (tests/system/test_delivery_stage_set.py, tests/domain/test_noloss*.py, tests/domain/test_briefing.py, tests/infrastructure/db/test_chaos.py, tests/live/**) must remain byte-untouched. Fix tests that fail under parallelism by improving their isolation, never by marking or skipping them. domain/ stays pure stdlib. All CI workflow changes must keep the existing gate names so branch protections keep matching.
